Attorney
- Name: Juan Campos, Esq. (Juan Manuel Campos Gutierrez)
- Admitted: Louisiana Supreme Court, 2020. Not admitted in Florida.
- Immigration is federal practice, so clients are represented before USCIS,
  the immigration courts (EOIR) and U.S. consulates from the Orlando office,
  including clients living in other states.
- Education: LL.M. in Comparative Law, University of Florida Levin College of
  Law, 2019. Law degree, Universidad Yacambu, Venezuela, 2006.
- Member: American Immigration Lawyers Association (AILA)
- Born in Coro, Venezuela.
